slides.headline: 5 AI SCAM TRICKS MOST PEOPLE ONLY LEARN AFTER LOSING MONEY
slides.image_prompt: A laptop in a warm living room shows a video call where participant tiles are caught mid-glitch — edges dissolving — as hands freeze reaching for a bank card, cold blue screen against warm amber, documentary news photo, 35mm, film grain, extremely realistic and shocking.

slides.headline: 1) SPOT THE CLONED FAMILY VOICE CALL
slides.body: In 2023, Arizona: a woman heard her daughter's voice sobbing, demanding $1 million. Her daughter was safe, voice cloned from TikTok. Hang up. Call back on your own contact.

slides.headline: 2) CATCH THE AI-WRITTEN PHISHING EMAIL
slides.body: The FBI tracked $2.7 billion in email scam losses in 2022. AI writes them with zero typos. Urgency plus a wire request: stop. Call that person on a number you look up yourself.

slides.headline: 3) TEST A DEEPFAKE LIVE VIDEO CALL
slides.body: In February 2024, Arup wired $25 million after a video call, the CFO and whole leadership team were AI-generated. Any video call payment request: verify on your company's own directory number.

slides.headline: 4) CATCH AN AI ROMANCE SCAMMER
slides.body: Americans lost $1.3 billion to romance scams in 2022. AI lets one person run hundreds of fake relationships at 3am, without sleeping. Paste their messages into Google in quotes, copied scripts show up.

slides.headline: 5) AVOID THE FAKE AI SUPPORT CHAT
slides.body: A scammer buys a Google ad for your bank's name. You click the top result, chat with a bot, and your login is gone. Never search your bank. Type the address yourself.

caption:
Swipe to see all 5. Scammers figured out how to use AI, and the tricks now sound and look completely real. 🚨

Slide 2 shows how scammers clone a family member's voice from social media audio and call relatives pretending to be in danger, slide 3 covers how AI now writes perfect phishing emails using your boss's real name with zero errors, slide 4 reveals how one company wired $25 million after a video call where every face on screen was AI-generated in real time, slide 5 shows how AI bots run hundreds of romance scams simultaneously around the clock without sleeping, and slide 6 explains how fake AI customer service chatbots intercept people searching online for their bank's support number.

These tricks cost almost nothing to run now. Voice cloning and deepfake video were impossible to fake convincingly a few years ago. Every business needs one rule: verify any payment request on a number you look up yourself, never from the message that came in.
